query: how do you root a yucca plant
passage: Dig around the root system of the yucca plant, roughly one foot out from the perimeter of the leaf spread. Push the shovel straight down into the ground and then slightly angle it inward, working your way down and under the roots. Repeat this digging process around the entire plant. Work your way around the trench again, using the shovel as a lever to lift the root ball of the plant upward.
